title: Viktor - packed crew animation strip
why: Make the cold-weather driver readable in the existing crew sprite family.
acceptance: Exactly one atlas region named dw_crew_viktor, 280x20 pixels, with binary transparency and only the listed palette names.
Preserve the large head, tiny right-facing eye, projecting nose, compact body and soot outline of the supplied existing-character reference.

An original older man driver with dark gray close-fitting fur cap with short ear flaps, pale weathered skin, dusty snow-blue winter coat with bone collar, charcoal trousers and brown boots, tiny gray beard cluster. Keep coat narrow like the original body.
No blur, antialiasing, fractional scaling, rotation, gradient pixels or isolated export specks; inspect at 1x and nearest 8x.
All 20 cells fit 14x20 with stable head, feet and accessories: idle 0-1; walk 2-5; sit 6; work 7-8; guitar 9-10; coffee 11-12; clean 13-14; hammer 15-17; carry 18-19.
Feet remain on the existing actor baseline with no clipping, unexpected pose jitter or missing tool/hand silhouettes.
notes: An original older man driver with dark gray close-fitting fur cap with short ear flaps, pale weathered skin, dusty snow-blue winter coat with bone collar, charcoal trousers and brown boots, tiny gray beard cluster. Keep coat narrow like the original body. Parent and anchor describe the matching atlas construction reference, not a second sprite attached in the world. frames.count=1 means ONE packed atlas region, not one gameplay pose. The region contains 20 horizontal 14x20 cells; do not emit _0.._19 regions. Use Atlas.DW_FRAMES and DW_FPS unchanged. Runtime actor stays bottom-center (-7,-20), at room FLOOR_Y=46.
